Thanks Sam — this is helpful. A few technical clarifications and a first-pass rollback checklist below.

Technical clarifications (so our MOP aligns to your hardware):
- Confirm the GPU sleds are the PCIe A100 80GB variant (we need the exact part # for driver/firmware compatibility).
- NVMe: is the controller vendor Samsung or Micron? We have different validation steps.

Rollback checklist (draft):
1) Pre-upgrade snapshot: preserve model KV cache backups and container images (we store on local NFS).
2) Staged upgrade on a single spare node / non-prod rack; run perf smoke tests (latency P95, throughput baseline).
3) Full rack upgrade in rolling fashion, halting on any tokenization or model-inference errors.
4) Immediate rollback: reimage affected node from pre-upgrade image + restore KV cache; target RTO 90 minutes per node.
5) Post-rollback validation: run a 10-min synthetic workload with 3 prompt categories and compare token-level outputs against baseline; if >2% functional regression, escalate to engineering.

I'm attaching a short rollback-checklist-v2.md (stub) and a small set of validation scripts we'll hand off. Also: if ThermoGen prefers, we can pre-stage an image and spare nodes at your DC under a custody agreement.

I'll incorporate your Jason contact into the checklist and propose an annotated runbook by Thu 2027-05-06.

Marissa
